verdict.rationale: Vanta's own docs describe a Trust Center: a branded portal with docs and live controls that automates access approvals, NDAs and security reviews for prospects. That covers the core of the story, but the evidence does not show every element as written. It never explicitly mentions certifications displayed publicly, a click-through NDA flow, or a publicly hosted page, and there is no independent corroboration. missing for 10: explicit certification badges/listing, click-through NDA mechanics, confirmation of a public hosted URL, independent or hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As a sales lead, I get a hosted public trust center — live control status, certifications, and reports shared under click-through NDA — that closes security reviews before they start

citations.quote: Trust Center puts your docs, live controls, and AI-powered answers in one branded portal, and automates access approvals and NDAs
Trust Center helps you automate time-consuming security reviews and gives your prospects the info they need to make a purchase decision.
